steps.content:
June 25, N.F. 115
The World Dome
The Great Expo Closing Ceremony

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: After nine extraordinary years, humanity's most magnificent gathering now approaches its triumphant conclusion, ushering in a new era of order and peace.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Looking back, we once marched through the shadows of adversity, forged in the fires of struggle, and measured the very borders of survival with our scars.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: But those days are behind us. Though disasters threaten, and though the storm of Mania rages on—so long as humanity stands united, marching forward together, the flame of civilization will be rekindled once more!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: And now, as we stand at the culmination of this historic gathering—marking both the close of one chapter and the dawn of a new era—we prepare to welcome the Commander-in-Chief, who will deliver a momentous address and review the assembled FAC troops. The stage is set, the moment is here. Let the FAC military equipment demonstration—our grand closing ceremony—begin!

Ceremonial cannons thunder in unison as the massive FAC equipment in the main hall activates, deploying anti-Mania barriers. Rows of soldiers march in flawless lockstep down the central avenue. The spectacle serves as a show of force, meant to inspire human resolve and project DisCity's indomitable might. Even military equipment from a decade past now stands ready for future sale.

The Outland delegations sit in their exclusive viewing section, their eyes fixed on humanity's greatest source of security—weapons they've never seen before, with blue Hypercubes flashing prominently on each device. An uncharacteristic silence hangs heavy among them.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It's not over yet, Chief. Stay focused.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Copy that.
You need to stay vigilant. If there's going to be an "incident," now would be the final opportunity.
Your terminal vibrates. You know the moment has come.
A gruesome image flashes on screen: a murdered person lies amidst rampant contamination, while a chilling, twisted message is scrawled in blood across the ground—

<size=55><color=#dg1f1f>TRAITORS WHO SIDE WITH DISCITY</size></color> 
<size=80><color=#dg1f1f>WILL NOT BE SPARED!!</size></color>

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Chief! Emergency! The Fraser Ambassador has been murdered inside the embassy with a message left. We're under attack!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Same here.
Sharp screams of terror erupt from the audience.
[Inside Parfait's Room]
In the Syndicate slums, several Outland assassins dart through narrow alleys, shoving aside people in their way until they precisely locate their target designation and kick the door open.
However, their assassination target—the publicly outspoken Furor inspector Sibilla—is nowhere to be found in this safe house.

steps.speaker: Fraser Assassin
steps.content: She's escaped?
[Scene Change] Parfait's Dinner Party
Meanwhile, inside the Medici Hotel, DisCity's wealthy elites exchange bewildered glances under the gilded gaze of The Golden City—a sprawling, fragmented masterpiece.

The contract with Fraser is signed, the investment secured, and the announcement—poised for strategic release—is ready to send a jolt through the market. Reporters, streamers, and influencers wait outside, eager for the breaking news. But at this pivotal moment, the event's host is missing.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Why isn't Parfait here yet... Did something go wrong...

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Hello? Did you find her? Is she alright? ...What?!!
[Scene Change] Hotel Lobby (any magnificent lobby would do)

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: What, Parfait is missing?!
Viewers flood into the livestream in an instant, with question marks and exclamation points frantically filling all the comments scrolling across the screen.

A commotion erupts throughout the lobby as waiters rush about, nervously escorting indignant VIP guests discreetly out of the building. Meanwhile, the opportunistic streamers and reporters burst into a frenzy of excitement, with wild conspiracy theories instantly running rampant.
Meanwhile, in an inconspicuous corner of the lobby, a person quietly sets down his coffee cup.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...Opportunity always favors the prepared, isn't that right, Adrian?
Max King gazes at the coffee on the table, its dark surface catching a faint glimmer of golden splendor around him. Maybe Parfait's Dinner Party isn't over after all—maybe it's only just begun.
[Scene Change] Back to the closing ceremony, war flame effect

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Attack—! There's an attack at the Great Expo! Oh god, they're killing people!!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Spies! Outland spies!! Help, hel—Aaah!!!

From the local audience seats, numerous "DisCity residents" tear off their disguises and launch their assault. Meanwhile, the FAC units that were performing on the main avenue immediately shift into combat mode. Though they aren't trained killers, their experience protecting civilians proves useful nonetheless.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Your foresight saved us, Chief. FAC combat units are already in position—just give the order. No enemy will reach our citizens. Not on our watch.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Then my priority is to ensure your safety, Chief. The FAC officers are still en route to the scene, and they have granted you temporary field command authority. Please proceed.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Move in as planned! Take them alive!
